verdict.rationale: Chargebee offers a REST API with official SDKs and a subscriptions resource, plus official MCP servers that let AI clients 'securely access selected capabilities'. Custom MCP servers expose only the tools a given agent needs, which gives scoped agent access. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that applying credits and changing plans are available as agent/MCP tools, documentation of restricted (non-full-access) API key scopes, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven billing writes.
